title: When the Supplier Calls About a Small Price Change

scenes.speaker: Sam
scenes.say: Quick heads up. Just a small price change.
Sam, the supplier. Flour's going up a little. How little? Like, a little a little. Sam. Also butter. And the cups.

messages.text: Morning! Flour's going up a little

scenes.say: What owners hear. Small change means more than last time. Just this month means forever. And everyone's going up? Means you're next.
Tag an owner who got this call this week. Follow for more cafe life.
